policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 1:2 reads "from God the Father" with no possessive; the ASV renders ἡμῶν elsewhere in the salutation formula when present (cf. "our Lord Jesus Christ"), so the bare "the Father" distinguishes πατρὸς without ἡμῶν.
A pure word-order variant: αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς and ἡμᾶς αὐτοὺς both yield ASV "we ourselves". The only note on 1:4 is an alternative_rendering on "patience", which cannot decide a reading.

ἐγκαυχᾶσθαι and its simplex καυχᾶσθαι are both rendered "glory" in English; the ASV supplies no intensive wording that would mark the compound, and the verse's only note is an alternative_rendering on "patience".

The ASV text shown for 1:8 begins at "rendering vengeance" and contains no rendering of the φλογὶ πυρός / πυρὶ φλογός phrase at all, so nothing in this verse distinguishes the order; the sole note is a greek_gloss on "gospel".
